variants.specifics: Brackenford: Garrick keeps the north gate, shut by Halvard against Red Corwin's bandits.

first.speaker: Garrick
first.text: Halvard, here is another traveller who wishes to try his luck with Red Corwin's bandits!

again.speaker: Garrick
again.text: Wanna see what's waiting up the north road?

later.speaker: Garrick
later.text: I don't hear much from Crow Hill anymore.

variants.specifics: Kal Vorra: Torg guards the big lift down to the mines, which Foreman Korvald has closed to all but working miners.

first.speaker: Torg
first.text: Only working miners may ride the lift!

again.speaker: Torg
again.text: Hey, you should find yourself a proper helmet.

variants.specifics: Velk: Brask at the Long Walk gate, kept shut until Mayor Quillon says otherwise.

first.speaker: Brask
first.text:
I would take it up with Mayor Quillon...
unless you want to rile him.

again.speaker: Brask
again.text: Truly stubborn! Off the planks, bog rat!

variants.specifics: Castle Tarbek: Brogan keeps the East Gate, shut by Commander Brask while Morvane's Undead hold the east road.

first.speaker: Brogan
first.text:
Hold it right there, stranger! Commander Brask has shut the East Gate to all travelers and Morvane's Undead on the east road are reason enough for it.

Back you go! I've got a cold and lonely post to keep here.

Will you move along quietly, stranger?

again.speaker: Brogan
again.text: What are you still doing here? The gate is shut tight! You'd better report to the barracks if you hope to get past me. Commander Brask awaits.

later.speaker: Brogan
later.text: Through the gate, lad! Unless you WANT to stand here all day!

variants.specifics: Kelm: Torvik at the lake road gate, shut by Mayor Gundrel while Vaskor's Zombies walk the shore.

first.speaker: Torvik
first.text: You look handy enough. But that won't get you through this gate! Now move along!

again.speaker: Torvik
again.text: Stay right there, stranger! Mayor Gundrel has shut the lake road to all comers and his seal on this order says so! Turn around. There's a dry bed waiting for you at the Bent Hook! Will you go quietly, stranger?

later.speaker: Torvik
later.text: You talked the Mayor into opening the gate!? You're mad! Now go on through! Don't come crying to me!

variants.specifics: Ostrel: Tobb keeps the College gate at night while Vaskar's Imps are about.

first.speaker: Tobb
first.text: Through the gate, stranger! Mind your manners!

again.speaker: Tobb
again.text: Do you believe what folks say about Vaskar?

later.speaker: Tobb
later.text: Well there go the last of the Imps. No more night watch, guess I'll go get some sleep.

variants.specifics: Fort Vestrin: Hulgar keeps the gate of Fort Vestrin while Morlak's skeletons come down the pass.

first.speaker: Hulgar
first.text: Shouldn't you be out on the pass smashing skeletons?

again.speaker: Hulgar
again.text: Those skeletons never would have reached our gate if Tolmar the Ranger had been on the wall!

later.speaker: Hulgar
later.text:
We have held it! The walls of Vestrin have never stood so proud as on this frozen day! Now we will rally behind Warden Brokk and carry the fight up to Morlak himself!

TO THE ICE TOWER! BROKK SHALL LEAD US TO VICTORY!

variants.specifics: Ostrak: Brugo guards the Slag Gate while Malgrath's Ember Demons raid the slag road.

first.speaker: Brugo
first.text: I'm under orders not to chat with outsiders.

again.speaker: Brugo
again.text: Don't lose heart now, stranger, those Ember Demons will crack under our hammers!

later.speaker: Brugo
later.text: No, nobody sleeps while Ember Demons walk the slag road!

variants.specifics: Tarrow Crossing: Thurl at the east gate of Tarrow Crossing, shut while Gorbash's Ogres hold Fort Grimmock.

first.speaker: Thurl
first.text: Hurry! Mayor Pellam is waiting for you upstairs in the Town Hall. There's a ladder behind the clerk's desk that will take you right up to him.

again.speaker: Thurl
again.text: We must hold this gate and make the Ogres pay for every wagon they've burned!

later.speaker: Thurl
later.text: Those big ugly Ogres and their drums used to keep me up all night.

variants.specifics: Tullin: Hessa keeps the south gate of Tullin and points the player to Mayor Gromwell.

first.speaker: Hessa
first.text: Well, well! You sure look tougher than the last few heroes! Come find me at the gate once you're done chasing off Ogres.

again.speaker: Hessa
again.text: You'll find Mayor Gromwell in the Grange Hall. He has the key to the north gate.

later.speaker: Hessa
later.text: You're the one who drove off the Ogres, aren't you? It's a shame you can't stay on in Tullin. I just love a hero!
